item.title: Understanding Dreamer: How World Models Learn to Imagine
item.description:
Dreamer Series · Part 1

This article covers Dreamer’s overall architecture at a conceptual level. If you’ve already read the RSSM Code Walkthrough Series, this article will help you connect the scattered code details into a coherent architectural understanding.

Dreamer’s most important idea is not “training a model that generates future frames,” but rather training a latent world model sufficient to support decision-making, then letting policies learn inside that internal world.
